memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Avery confirmed the Thursday evening return after the gallery fixed the review end time, compared three currently available Denver hotels by total cost and early-morning route, and booked the Delta itinerary plus a three-night Catbird studio king within the employer authorization.

messages.content: The gallery has confirmed that Thursday’s review will be finished by 4:00 p.m., so I can take the 6:40 Delta flight home that evening. I also need a room Monday through Thursday near the installation site. Can you check the whole trip against the approved amount before I buy anything?

Yes. I’ll use the Monday, August 18 Delta outbound at 11:05 a.m. and the Thursday, August 21 return at 6:40 p.m. What is the gallery address, and does the approved amount cover airfare and lodging together?
The installation is at 3400 Walnut Street in Denver. The authorization should already be attached to this trip, and it covers airfare and the hotel together. Local transportation is separate.

I found the authorization. The approved combined ceiling is $1,350 for airfare and lodging, excluding local transportation and any reimbursable airline bag fee. The Delta round trip is still available at $446 in Main Cabin. That leaves $904 for three hotel nights including taxes. I’ll check Monday, August 18 through Thursday, August 21, with a route that is dependable for the Tuesday morning installation.
Good. I need to be at the gallery by 7:30 Tuesday morning, so show me the route as well as the total.

Three currently available options fit the authorization. The Source Hotel has a king room for $247 per night. With $111.84 in taxes and fees, the three-night total is $852.84. It is about 1.1 miles from the gallery: roughly 6 minutes by car at 7:00 a.m. or about a 22-minute walk. The combined trip total would be $1,298.84. The room can be canceled without charge until 6:00 p.m. local time on August 17.

Catbird has a studio king at $204 per night. Taxes and fees bring the stay to $704.16. It is about 0.8 mile away, approximately 5 minutes by car or a 17-minute walk. Combined with the flight, the trip would total $1,150.16. Free cancellation ends at 4:00 p.m. local time on August 16.

Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver has a king room at $194 per night, totaling $670.47 after taxes and fees. It is about 2.5 miles from the gallery, normally 9 to 14 minutes by car that morning. The combined total would be $1,116.47. It is refundable until 11:59 p.m. local time on August 16.
Does the Source rate have anything added besides the room and mandatory taxes? I don’t want the comparison distorted by an optional package.

No optional package is included. The Source total consists of $741 in room charges, $110.34 in lodging taxes, and a mandatory $1.50 public-improvement fee, for $852.84 total. No breakfast package, parking, room upgrade, or travel coverage is selected.
And is Catbird actually walkable that early, or would the route put me on an awkward industrial stretch?

The route is walkable, primarily along Brighton Boulevard and Walnut Street, but several blocks have active commercial loading areas and construction crossings. At that hour, a car is the more predictable option and is currently estimated at 5 minutes. The Source route is slightly longer on foot but has a similarly straightforward car trip. Either property can arrange a taxi, and app-based rides operate in the area.
What time would I need to leave the gallery Thursday for the 6:40 flight? The review ending at 4:00 is firm, but it may take ten minutes to wrap up.

For the 6:40 p.m. departure from Denver International, Delta currently recommends arriving by 5:10 p.m. if checking a bag. From the gallery, the drive is estimated at 30 to 45 minutes at that time. Leaving by 4:20 p.m. gives a reasonable path to arrive between 4:50 and 5:05, though traffic can vary. Leaving at 4:10 would provide more margin. All three hotels offer complimentary luggage storage after checkout, so you can check out Thursday morning and collect your bag before the review only if practical; alternatively, taking it to the gallery avoids a return trip.
I’ll take the bag to the gallery. Please confirm the Delta fare details again, including whether the Thursday flight is nonstop and the current seat situation.

The itinerary is still available for $446 round trip in Main Cabin. Outbound: Delta nonstop from Atlanta at 11:05 a.m. Monday, August 18, arriving Denver at 12:25 p.m. Return: Delta nonstop from Denver at 6:40 p.m. Thursday, August 21, arriving Atlanta at 11:32 p.m. Standard seat selection is included. Several aisle, middle, and window seats remain on both flights, mostly behind the exit rows. A checked bag is $35 each way unless your account or payment method provides a waiver. The ticket can be canceled for an eCredit under the displayed Main Cabin rules; it is not refundable to the original payment method after the 24-hour risk-free cancellation period.
I’m leaning toward the Source because the Tuesday start is the critical part. How much room does that leave in the authorization, and is there any deposit at booking?

The $1,298.84 combined total leaves $51.16 under the $1,350 authorization. The Source requires a card guarantee but does not charge a deposit now. The full $852.84 is due at the hotel. If canceled after 6:00 p.m. Denver time on August 17, the penalty is one night’s room and tax, currently $284.28.
Before I commit, compare the Source and Catbird rooms themselves. I’ll be working on installation notes at night.

The Source king is 300 square feet and includes a desk, task chair, mini-refrigerator, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The available Catbird studio king is 365 square feet with a larger worktable, kitchenette, mini-refrigerator, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Catbird offers more in-room workspace and costs $148.68 less for the stay. The Source has the slightly shorter estimated morning drive from the gallery-facing side of the neighborhood, but the difference is about one minute under current traffic estimates.
That changes it. The larger work surface is useful, and five minutes by car is still fine. Is Catbird’s studio king still available at that total?

Yes. I refreshed availability: the studio king remains available for August 18-21 at $704.16 including all mandatory taxes and fees. No optional extras are selected. Combined with the $446 Delta itinerary, the authorized trip total would be $1,150.16, leaving $199.84 under the ceiling.

Then book the Delta Monday outbound with the Thursday 6:40 return, and reserve the Catbird studio king for three nights. Use my work traveler profile and card on file. No optional coverage, upgrades, or hotel add-ons.

Before purchase, one detail needs confirmation: the Delta seat map currently shows standard window seats 24A and 25F on the outbound and 22A and 26F on the return at no added charge. Would you like me to select specific seats, or leave seat assignment open?
Select 24A outbound and 22A returning, provided both are still free, and complete it.

Both reservations are confirmed. Delta ticket DL-5829417630 is for Atlanta to Denver nonstop on Monday, August 18 at 11:05 a.m., seat 24A, returning Denver to Atlanta nonstop on Thursday, August 21 at 6:40 p.m., seat 22A. The ticket charged to the work card is $446. The 24-hour risk-free cancellation deadline is 11:47 a.m. Eastern on August 9; after that, the displayed Main Cabin eCredit rules apply. Checked bags are not included unless a waiver applies.

Catbird confirmation CB-418726 is for one studio king, one adult, checking in Monday, August 18 and checking out Thursday, August 21. The confirmed total is $704.16, due at the property; the card on file guarantees the room and has not been charged. Cancellation is free until 4:00 p.m. Denver time on August 16, after which a one-night room-and-tax penalty applies. No coverage, upgrades, or optional add-ons were purchased. The combined confirmed amount is $1,150.16, which is $199.84 below the approved ceiling.

Catbird confirmation CB-418726 is for one studio king from August 18-21 at $704.16, due at the property, with free cancellation until 4:00 p.m. Denver time August 16.
